subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw expose this non-integrity cross-provider model diagnostics stream as public Plugin SDK, or require provider- or capability-scoped usage delivery instead?
rationale: The allowlist and safeguards can be reviewed mechanically, but only maintainers can authorize the durable public API and telemetry-access policy.

options.title: Accept allowlisted diagnostics
options.body: Ship the focused listener after exact-head gates pass, retaining the explicit non-integrity contract and compatibility tests.

options.title: Require scoped usage delivery
options.body: Replace the cross-provider listener with provider ownership or explicit capability gating for model usage events.

options.title: Defer public model telemetry
options.body: Keep trusted model events internal until a canonical usage API is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Accept allowlisted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Ship the focused listener after exact-head gates pass, retaining the explicit non-integrity contract and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current diagnostic dispatcher implementation and the provenance, isolation, and lifecycle invariants the new listener must preserve.
